0.original: One man's scourge is another man's chance to splurge, and Lieutenant Scarlet can help you find reason in this rhyme.

1.original: Lieutenant Scarlet informs you that the Eorzean Alliance has instituted a bounty system called the Hunt. For the finer points of this most profitable venture, you must speak with the Hunt billmaster within the Adders' Nest.

2.original: The Hunt billmaster has briefed you on the fundamentals of the Hunt. Whether you seek more advice or wish to spend your hard-earned Allied Seals, he is the man with whom you must speak. Do your part to preserve the peace, and you will be richly rewarded.

24.original: Speak with the Hunt billmaster at the Adders' Nest.

48.original: Gloryhounds such as yourself will be pleased to have this news from the powers that be: the Eorzean Alliance has established a new system known as the Hunt.

49.original: We never lack for creatures and men that disturb the sylvan serenity. Henceforth these miscreants shall be <hex:021A020203>marked<hex:021A020103> for felling, and whoever deals the blow shall collect a reward. 'Tis a bounty system, when all's said and done.

50.original: The Alliance makes much of this joining of sword hands, while allowing rivalries to go unchecked elsewhere. Small wonder that some see a bent branch where we claim a bough true and proud.

51.original: But these are matters for our betters to ponder. For now, you may serve by offering the Hunt your considerable talent for slaughter.

52.original: The bounty is rich, and you stand to gain much for your services. But don't take my word for it─speak with the Hunt billmaster to learn of rewards and other such details.

53.original: The Hunt is a bounty system when all's said and done, and a rich bounty it is indeed. Ask the Hunt billmaster if you would know more.

54.original: Here to join the Hunt, are you? Excellent, excellent. I'll get right into the explanation.

55.original: First things first, you'll want to take a look at this Hunt board. There are bills for all sorts of marks here.

56.original: There are <hex:021A020203>two<hex:021A020103> kinds of bills. The kind for regular marks and the kind for elite marks. The second of these are the more <hex:021A020203>notorious<hex:021A020103> sort. Before you go after one of them, I recommend you consult a hunter-scholar. These people are veterans of the Hunt who can recite the Raimdelle Codex by heart.

57.original: Once the Hunt's done, you'll receive tokens called Allied Seals, which you can exchange for exclusive wares.

58.original: If any of that got stuck going down, you're welcome to come back and ask again...and again, no doubt. I can attend to any Allied Seals you'd like to spend as well.

59.original: Wood's will be done, <hex:>. If I don't hear from you soon, I'll take it you weren't Hunt material...or that a mark got the best of you. Oh, do cheer up. Better to die once than live ever in shame.
